'''Law and crime'''
*[[Crime in South Africa]]
**Eighteen people are killed and 14 more are injured in a [[List of mass shootings in South Africa|mass shooting]] carried out by eight gunmen at a [[tavern]] in Wedela township, [[Gauteng]], [[South Africa]]. [[South African Police Service|Police]] launch a [[Manhunt (law enforcement)|manhunt]] for the gunmen. It is suspected that the shooting is linked to a dispute over [[Illegal mining|illegal gold mining]]. [https://www.citizen.co.za/news/south-africa/crime/tavern-shooting-near-carletonville/ (''The Citizen'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-african-police-death-toll-weekend-tavern-shooting-rises-18-2026-09-28/ (Reuters)]
**Four people are killed in a mass shooting by unknown gunmen on a street in the township of [[Khayelitsha]] in [[Cape Flats]], South Africa. [https://smilefm.co.za/four-people-killed-in-khayelitsha/ (Smile)]
**The body of a murdered woman is found in [[City of Ekurhuleni Metropolitan Municipality|Ekurhuleni]], South Africa. She is the tenth woman found killed in the city in the last three months. Police says that it can not rule out the possibility that the killings are carried out by a [[serial killer]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3vgyyj8q807o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[India]]'s [[Election Commission of India|Election Commission]] orders a review of its [[Electoral roll|voter-roll]] software after concerns arise over changes that excluded millions of voters. A committee will examine whether the software complied with [[Elections in India|election]] laws and rules. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indias-election-commission-orders-review-voter-roll-changes-2026-09-26/ (Reuters)]
